description: Crater lakes measured by Earth Engine run A (LAYERS-PLAN §7 steps 4-5). 'core' is a disc well inside the lake, used for surface temperature so the lake edge (mixed land and water pixels) is left out; 'crater' is a disc inside the crater rim, used for water area and colour, kept clear of any surrounding lake. Centres and radii were set by hand and checked on 2026-10-22 with the single-image smoke test (JRC GSW, March 2019): water share of the core disc 0.99 at Taal and 1.00 at Pinatubo; water in the crater disc 1.12 km² (22 %) at Taal and 1.74 km² (25 %) at Pinatubo, so neither crater disc reaches Taal Lake or the caldera walls' runoff. 'gone' lists spans when the lake was absent: no temperature is reported there, and the charts show the span. An 'end' of null means the span ends at the first Sentinel-2 scene that sees the lake again (derived from the area series, not typed by hand).
